properties.name: Thickness
properties.description: Sheet metal thickness. 0 builds the air space as a solid body instead of a hollow shell

properties.name: InsulationThickness
properties.description: Insulation thickness wrapped around the outside of the fitting; 0 disables insulation

properties.name: TrimMain
properties.description: Additional trim beyond the intrinsic body on the common/main leg

properties.name: TrimBranchA
properties.description: Additional trim beyond the intrinsic body on branch A

properties.name: TrimBranchB
properties.description: Additional trim beyond the intrinsic body on branch B

properties.name: BranchRadius
properties.description: Reference centerline radius used to position the mitered branch bends

properties.name: NumberOfCuts
properties.description: Number of internal mitre joints in each branch bend

properties.name: FlangeHeight
properties.description: Height of the transverse flange at each duct connection

properties.name: FlangeThickness
properties.description: Thickness of the transverse flange; 0 draws no flanges

properties.name: ShowFlangeMain
properties.description: Include the flange at the main (common) duct

properties.name: ShowFlangeBranchA
properties.description: Include the flange at branch A

properties.name: ShowFlangeBranchB
properties.description: Include the flange at branch B
